analysis_coding: Centre indicators, Brigham and Women's Hospital as reference

definition: Calendar date in ISO 8601 format for surgery date; blanks mean that this date was not documented or not applicable. Released field: surgery date. Table context: the one-row-per-patient analysis table.

definition: Earliest documented start of ANY postoperative oncological treatment (radiotherapy or androgen deprivation), whatever its intent.
missingness_semantics: Blank means no day-resolution treatment date is documented. It does NOT mean untreated - read postoperative_treatment_any_documented and first_postoperative_treatment_date_precision.
analysis_coding: Interim treatment when the first radiotherapy or androgen deprivation therapy fell after the three-month and on or before the one-year assessment day

definition: Was any nerve (neurovascular bundle) sparing performed at the prostatectomy?
missingness_semantics: Blank means the question was never put to this patient - no source of this kind exists for them (for a Polish registry column, the patient has no registry row at all). It never means no. not_assessed means the source was searched and is silent. unknown_after_review means the source was read and does not settle it. not_performed is a positive statement that the procedure or test did not happen. Vocabulary: this column uses the procedure four-state code, because a surgical technique is something performed.
analysis_coding: not_performed, and not_assessed or unknown_after_review, each vs performed

definition: Ordinal number of this operation within the operating surgeon's series, over the operations captured in this cohort.
